purpose: Document the 2012 precinct-geography repairs used by the NHGIS block-disaggregation pilot.

sources.vest_rdh_2016_block_file: Data/tn_2016_gen_2020_blocks.zip (local source file supplied by the project owner)

implemented_repairs.montgomery: 2012 labels are assigned to the union of all 2010 Census VTDs sharing the same leading precinct number.
implemented_repairs.wilson: 2012 labels are assigned to the union of all 2010 Census VTDs sharing the same leading precinct number; this replaces an erroneous trailing-token match for precinct 9-3.
implemented_repairs.sullivan: 17 lettered precinct codes with unambiguous polling-place matches are assigned to 2010 VTDs; nine uncertain renamed locations remain on county fallback.
implemented_repairs.washington: 12 unique polling-place or city-side matches are assigned to 2010 VTDs; unresolved labels remain on county fallback.
implemented_repairs.knox: Five exact polling-place/code matches are assigned to single VTDs or explicit VTD unions.
implemented_repairs.madison: Eight exact 2010 VTD-code and polling-place matches are assigned to VTDs.

stable_2016_block_proxy_pilot.method: Use the supplied VEST/RDH 2016-on-2020-block file only where a normal election-day precinct retained the same distinctive code or name from 2012 through 2016.

house_ballot_constrained_fallback_pilot.method: Allocate each fallback bucket among 2012 State House districts in proportion to that bucket's State House votes, then distribute within each old-plan district using block VAP.

house_75_president.finding: The flip is driven entirely by Montgomery precinct geometry, not non-geographic fallback.

house_80_us_senate.finding: Only about 2.4% of raw pilot votes come from constrained fallback; the flip is principally a historical VTD-to-current-district geography issue.

publication_blockers: State House still has 154541 presidential votes allocated by countywide fallback inside split counties.
The largest House changes are concentrated in Hamilton-area districts 27-30; most unresolved Hamilton votes are non-geographic early, absentee, military, nursing-home, or provisional totals.
Historical Davidson precinct polygons for the new 2012 precinct labels have not been recovered.
Publishing now would introduce House margin changes as large as 21.5432 percentage points for president and 24.1614 points for U.S. Senate.
